{{Top|leg}}
A '''chemist''' was a student of chemistry. Chemists study the properties of chemical substances and compounds. When [[Captain-Supervisor]] [[Grammel]] demanded to know the properties of a shard of the [[Kaiburr crystal]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] protested that he was not a chemist.
